summary: Cessna 310H (N1099Q) on a personal VFR flight from Flagstaff, Arizona, to Amarillo, Texas, flew into mountainous terrain near Silverton in instrument conditions about 2:08 p.m.; all four aboard were killed. NTSB final report (CEN15FA400) attributed the crash to the non-instrument-rated pilots loss of situational awareness and controlled flight into terrain.
responding_agency: San Juan County Search and Rescue; La Plata County Search and Rescue (airlifted to the remote site by a Colorado Air National Guard helicopter)
notes: Victims: pilot Harold Raggio, 72; Steven Wilkinson, 59; Rosalinda Leslie, 57; Michael Lyle Riley, 59. SAR teams photographed at the wreckage on 2015-09-07; daughter reported the plane overdue on 2015-09-06.
